
## Setup

```{r}
# Load data
df_params <- read_csv(
  "/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_params_study5_for_r.csv"
)

# Prepare variables
df_params <- df_params %>%
  mutate(
    participant = factor(participant),

    task = factor(
      task,
      levels = c("predict", "accommodate")
    ),

    irrelevant_dim = factor(
      irrelevant_dim,
      levels = c("stripes", "feet")
    ),

    time = factor(
      time,
      levels = c("mid", "end")
    ),

    # Overfit is coded as 0/1
    overfit = as.integer(overfit %in% c(TRUE, 1, "TRUE", "True", "1"))
  )

# Effect / sum coding
contrasts(df_params$task) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_params$irrelevant_dim) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_params$time) <- contr.sum(2)

# Check coding
contrasts(df_params$task)
contrasts(df_params$irrelevant_dim)
contrasts(df_params$time)

# Mixed-effects logistic regression with a participant random intercept
model_overfit <- glmer(
  overfit ~ task * irrelevant_dim * time +
    (1 | participant),
  data = df_params,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000)
  )
)

summary(model_overfit)
```
```{r}
emm <- emmeans(model_overfit, ~ task * time, type = "response")
emm

pairs(emm)
car::Anova(model_overfit, type = 3)
```


```{r}
df_long4 <- read_csv('/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_long_for_R-Study5.csv') |>
  mutate(
    task = relevel(factor(task), ref = "predict"),
    feature_relevance = relevel(factor(feature_relevance), ref = "irrelevant"),
    feature_dimension = relevel(factor(feature_dimension), ref = "stripes"),
    time = relevel(factor(time), ref = "mid"),
    stripes_high = relevel(factor(stripes_high), ref = "E"),
    feet_high = relevel(factor(feet_high), ref = "C")
  )
```

```{r}
contrasts(df_long4$task) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_long4$feature_relevance) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_long4$feature_dimension) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_long4$time) <- contr.sum(2)

model_eff <- lmer(
  feature_importance ~ task * feature_relevance *
    feature_dimension * time +
    (1 + feature_relevance|participant),
  data = df_long4
)
summary(model_eff)
```

```{r}
emm <- emmeans(model_eff, ~ feature_relevance | time)
pairs(emm)
emm <- emmeans(model_eff, ~ time | feature_relevance)
pairs(emm)
```

```{r}
emm_task <- emmeans(model_eff, ~ feature_dimension)
pairs(emm_task)

```

```{r}
emm <- emmeans(
  model_eff,
  ~ task * feature_relevance * feature_dimension
)

emm
pairs(
  emm,
  by = c("feature_relevance", "feature_dimension")
)
```

```{r}
df_corr <- read_csv('/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_corr_for_R_Study5.csv') |>
  mutate(
    task = factor(task),
    feature_relevance = factor(feature_relevance),
    feature_dimension = factor(feature_dimension)
  )

# Effect / sum coding
contrasts(df_corr$task) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_corr$feature_relevance) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_corr$feature_dimension) <- contr.sum(2)

model_corr_raw_eff <- lmer(
  correlation ~ task * feature_relevance * feature_dimension +
    (1 | participant),
  data = df_corr
)

summary(model_corr_raw_eff)
```

```{r}
model_corr_raw_eff <- lmer(
  abs_correlation ~ task * feature_relevance * feature_dimension + (1|participant),
  data = df_corr
)

summary(model_corr_raw_eff)
```
